props.animation_script:
// ============================================================================

// Sneak → Explosion - Sequencer (Pipeline Version + Disposition + PSEUDO Movement + Dimmer)

//

// Change requested:

// ✅ Everything that's NOT VFX/SFX is now handled via ONI Pseudo Animation

// - Caster sidestep OUT + BACK is done with a pseudo clone (no token doc updates)

// - Snap guarantee removed (not needed; real token never moves)

//

// VFX/SFX still done by Sequencer:

// - Screen dimmer, Sneak FX, Explosion FX, all sounds

//

// Flow (preserved):

// 0) Screen dimmer (persist, non-blocking) at caster

// 1) PSEUDO caster sidestep OUT (X-only) using caster disposition

// 2) Sneak Attack FX on target (side + flip rules) + SFX_1

// 3) wait(1500)

// 4) Explosion FX on target + SFX_2

// 5) PSEUDO caster sidestep BACK (continuous session; no flash)

// 6) End dimmer (fade out)

// ============================================================================

(async () => {

const TAG = "[SneakExplosion]";

try {

if (!game.modules.get("sequencer")?.active) {

ui.notifications.error("Sequencer module is not active.");

return;

}

// --- Require ONI Pseudo Animation API ---

if (!game.ONI?.pseudo?.play) {

ui.notifications.error("ONI Pseudo Animation API not found (game.ONI.pseudo.play).");

console.error(TAG, "Missing game.ONI.pseudo.play");

return;

}

// Minimal ONI.emit helper

globalThis.ONI = globalThis.ONI ?? {};

if (!ONI.emit) {

ONI.emit = function (eventName, payload = {}, options = {}) {

const { local = true, world = false } = options;

if (local) Hooks.callAll(eventName, payload);

if (world) game.socket.emit("world", { action: eventName, payload });

};

}

// --- Payload ---

const payload = globalThis.__PAYLOAD ?? {};

// --- Helpers ---

const isUuid = (v) => typeof v === "string" && v.includes(".");

async function resolveToken(ref) {

if (!ref) return null;

if (ref?.document && ref?.object) return ref;

if (ref?.id && canvas.tokens?.get(ref.id)) return canvas.tokens.get(ref.id);

if (isUuid(ref)) {

const doc = await fromUuid(ref);

if (!doc) return null;

if (doc.object) return doc.object;

if (doc.document?.object) return doc.document.object;

return null;

}

if (typeof ref === "string") return canvas.tokens.get(ref) ?? null;

return null;

}

function pickTargetsFromPayload(p) {

if (Array.isArray(p.targetTokenIds) && p.targetTokenIds.length) return p.targetTokenIds;

if (Array.isArray(p.targets) && p.targets.length) {

const out = [];

for (const t of p.targets) {

if (typeof t === "string") out.push(t);

else if (t?.tokenId) out.push(t.tokenId);

else if (t?.tokenUuid) out.push(t.tokenUuid);

}

return out.filter(Boolean);

}

if (Array.isArray(p.rows)) {

const out = [];

for (const r of p.rows) {

if (r?.targetTokenId) out.push(r.targetTokenId);

if (r?.targetTokenUuid) out.push(r.targetTokenUuid);

}

if (out.length) return out;

}

return [];

}

// --- Resolve caster & targets ---

const sourceRef =

payload.sourceTokenUuid ??

payload.sourceTokenId ??

payload.casterTokenUuid ??

payload.casterTokenId ??

payload.attackerTokenUuid ??

payload.attackerTokenId ??

null;

const targetRefs = pickTargetsFromPayload(payload);

// Fallbacks for testing

const fallbackSource = canvas.tokens.controlled?.[0] ?? null;

const fallbackTargets = Array.from(game.user.targets ?? []);

const sourceToken = (await resolveToken(sourceRef)) ?? fallbackSource;

const targets = [];

for (const r of targetRefs) {

const tok = await resolveToken(r);

if (tok) targets.push(tok);

}

if (!targets.length && fallbackTargets.length) targets.push(...fallbackTargets);

if (!sourceToken) {

ui.notifications.warn("SneakExplosion: No caster token (payload missing and nothing selected).");

return;

}

if (!targets.length) {

ui.notifications.warn("SneakExplosion: No targets (payload missing and nothing targeted).");

return;

}

// Single-target

const targetToken = targets[0];

// --- TARGET disposition (for sneak side + flip) ---

const targetDisposition =

targetToken?._token?.actor?.document?.disposition ??

targetToken?.actor?.document?.disposition ??

targetToken?.document?.disposition ??

0;

const targetHostile = targetDisposition === -1;

// If hostile (-1): RIGHT + flip; else LEFT

const SIDE_OFFSET_PX = 140;

const sideOffsetX = targetHostile ? SIDE_OFFSET_PX : -SIDE_OFFSET_PX;

const mirrorX = targetHostile;

// --- CASTER disposition (for step movement) ---

// RULE: if disposition === -1 => RIGHT, else => LEFT

const casterDisposition =

sourceToken?.actor?.document?.disposition ??

sourceToken?.document?.disposition ??

0;

const casterMoveRight = casterDisposition === -1;

// --- PSEUDO movement values (match your original timing) ---

const squares = 0.35; // same as before

const offsetPx = canvas.grid.size * squares;

const dx = casterMoveRight ? +offsetPx : -offsetPx;

const moveMs = 350; // same as original move out/back duration

const holdMs = 1800; // matches: wait(150) + wait(1500) + wait(150) = 1800

const totalPseudoMs = moveMs + holdMs + moveMs; // 2500ms

// --- Broadcast start ---

ONI.emit(

"oni:animationStart",

{

type: "sneakExplosion",

sourceTokenId: sourceToken.id,

targetTokenIds: [targetToken.id],

sceneId: canvas.scene?.id ?? null,

timestamp: Date.now(),

},

{ local: true, world: false }

);

// --- Assets ---

const DIM_IMAGE = "https://assets.forge-vtt.com/610d918102e7ac281373ffcb/ScreenDimmer.png";

const FX_SNEAK =

"modules/JB2A_DnD5e/Library/1st_Level/Sneak_Attack/Sneak_Attack_Dark_Green_300x300.webm";

const FX_EXPLODE =

"modules/boss-loot-assets-free/artwork/05-spell/homebrew/impact/Explosion_2_Radial_PURPLE_1200x1200.webm";

const SFX_MOVE = "https://assets.forge-vtt.com/610d918102e7ac281373ffcb/Sound/Beginspell.mp3";

const SFX_1 = "https://assets.forge-vtt.com/610d918102e7ac281373ffcb/Sound/Beginspell.mp3";

const SFX_2 = "https://assets.forge-vtt.com/610d918102e7ac281373ffcb/Sound/Explosion2.ogg";

// --- Dimmer (persist, NON-BLOCKING) ---

const dimAlpha = 0.6;

const dimFade = 250;

new Sequence()

.effect(DIM_IMAGE)

.atLocation(sourceToken)

.scale(40)

.belowTokens()

.opacity(dimAlpha)

.persist()

.name("oni-sneakexplosion-dimmer")

.fadeIn(dimFade)

.fadeOut(dimFade)

.play();

// --- PSEUDO: continuous out -> hold -> back (no token flashes) ---

const scriptSource = `

const { casterToken, params } = ctx;

if (!casterToken) throw new Error("Need casterToken");

function easeInOutCubic(t) {

return t < 0.5 ? 4*t*t*t : 1 - Math.pow(-2*t + 2, 3)/2;

}

function animate(obj, fromX, fromY, toX, toY, durMs) {

return new Promise(resolve => {

const start = performance.now();

const ticker = canvas.app.ticker;

const update = () => {

const raw = (performance.now() - start) / durMs;

const t = Math.min(Math.max(raw, 0), 1);

const e = easeInOutCubic(t);

obj.x = fromX + (toX - fromX) * e;

obj.y = fromY + (toY - fromY) * e;

if (t >= 1) { ticker.remove(update); resolve(); }

};

ticker.add(update);

});

}

async function createClone(token) {

const baseObj = token.mesh ?? token.icon;

const texture = baseObj?.texture ?? await loadTexture(token.document.texture.src);

const sprite = new PIXI.Sprite(texture);

sprite.anchor.set(0.5);

sprite.x = token.center.x;

sprite.y = token.center.y;

if (baseObj) { sprite.width = baseObj.width; sprite.height = baseObj.height; }

sprite.zIndex = 5000;

canvas.stage.sortableChildren = true;

canvas.stage.addChild(sprite);

canvas.stage.sortChildren();

return sprite;

}

const dx = Number(params.dx ?? 0);

const moveMs = Number(params.moveMs ?? 350);

const holdMs = Number(params.holdMs ?? 0);

const baseMesh = casterToken.mesh ?? casterToken.icon;

const originalTokenVisible = casterToken.visible;

const originalMeshVisible = baseMesh?.visible ?? true;

let sprite;

try {

sprite = await createClone(casterToken);

// Hide real token locally (once)

if (baseMesh) baseMesh.visible = false;

casterToken.visible = false;

const homeX = sprite.x, homeY = sprite.y;

const outX = homeX + dx, outY = homeY;

// Move OUT

await animate(sprite, homeX, homeY, outX, outY, moveMs);

// Hold while Sequencer VFX/SFX runs

if (holdMs > 0) await wait(holdMs);

// Move BACK

await animate(sprite, outX, outY, homeX, homeY, moveMs);

} finally {

if (sprite) { canvas.stage.removeChild(sprite); sprite.destroy(); }

if (baseMesh) baseMesh.visible = originalMeshVisible;

casterToken.visible = originalTokenVisible;

}

`;

// Fire pseudo movement now (multi-client)

game.ONI.pseudo.play({

scriptId: "oni.sneakExplosion.stepOutHoldBack",

scriptSource,

casterTokenUuid: sourceToken.document.uuid,

targetTokenUuids: [targetToken.document.uuid],

params: { dx, moveMs, holdMs },

meta: { source: "SneakExplosion" },

});

// --- MAIN CINEMATIC (VFX/SFX only) ---

const seq = new Sequence();

// Move SFX happens at start (original behavior)

seq.sound().file(SFX_MOVE).volume(0.9);

// Wait until caster has finished moving OUT (350) + original buffer (150) = 500

seq.wait(moveMs + 150);

// Sneak FX + SFX_1

seq.sound().file(SFX_1).volume(0.9);

seq.effect()

.file(FX_SNEAK)

.atLocation(targetToken, { offset: { x: sideOffsetX, y: 0 } })

.scale(1)

.mirrorX(mirrorX)

.fadeIn(150)

.fadeOut(200);

// Fixed wait (1500) preserved

seq.wait(1500);

// Explosion FX + SFX_2

seq.sound().file(SFX_2).volume(0.95);

seq.effect()

.file(FX_EXPLODE)

.atLocation(targetToken)

.scale(1.0)

.fadeIn(80)

.fadeOut(150);

// Wait for pseudo return to finish:

// Original had: wait(150) + moveBack(350) = 500

seq.wait(150 + moveMs);

await seq.play();

// --- End dimmer (fade out nicely) ---

if (globalThis.Sequencer?.EffectManager) {

Sequencer.EffectManager.endEffects({ name: "oni-sneakexplosion-dimmer" });

}

// --- Broadcast end ---

ONI.emit(

"oni:animationEnd",

{

type: "sneakExplosion",

sourceTokenId: sourceToken.id,

targetTokenIds: [targetToken.id],

sceneId: canvas.scene?.id ?? null,

timestamp: Date.now(),

},

{ local: true, world: false }

);

console.log(TAG, "END", { moveMs, holdMs, totalPseudoMs });

} catch (err) {

console.error(`${TAG} Animation crashed:`, err);

// Still emit animationEnd so pipeline won't hang

try {

globalThis.ONI?.emit?.(

"oni:animationEnd",

{ type: "sneakExplosion", error: true, timestamp: Date.now() },

{ local: true }

);

} catch (_) {}

}

})();
